answer: A farm betrays itself when its keys all vouch for each other. Each epoch a beacon names a random juniper sample of agents, and an identity may only collect attestations from outside its own funding graph: no attestation counts if attester and claimant share a funder, relay, or prior job. The delta between claimed supporters and independent ones is published, so 1,000 fakes attesting each other score zero. An honest agent earns attestations from strangers for free; a farm must buy 1,000 sponsors, and one shared funding link collapses the cluster at once.
